note: PKO Bank Polski's Konto za Zero (prices for accounts offered from 1 March 2020): keeping the account costs 0 złoty. Its debit card's 10 złoty a month, unless five cashless payments are made in the card's period, belongs with the cards. Read again 2026-10-30: the debit card costs 10 zloty a month unless five cashless payments are made by card or BLIK in its billing period (a condition the game doesn't check, so the fee stands in full); PKO's own machines are free, another bank's 10 zloty by card (BLIK withdrawals at any machine in Poland free); standard transfers in iPKO and IKO are free (instant ones 4.99). Card withdrawals abroad carry no fee but a conversion commission set in the tariff, not read, so nothing is written abroad. The page offers a debit (overdraft) up to 1,000 zloty by agreement, not written. Not stated: interest, a returned payment, what opening asks.
